tasks.title: Implement kreuzberg integration (Stage 1 of #341) — MCP datum for document intelligence
tasks.description: Issue #398 (latent space) identified that kreuzberg integration (issue #341) is at 0% implementation. Stage 1: Create _b00t_/kreuzberg.mcp.toml datum, register kreuzberg MCP server, validate text extraction from PDFs. Blocks paper parsing end-to-end in b00t ecosystem.
tasks.result: kreuzberg MCP datum exists, MCP wrapper built (3 tools: extract_file, extract_bytes, list_formats), end-to-end validated with kreuzberg v4.9.9. Upstream MCP server path (uvx kreuzberg-mcp) noted for future when upstream ships it.
